_doc: [camp] The landing yard (systems/camp/camp.gd, systems/camp/yard_builds.gd). A fresh base starts with only the pod, a broken workbench and the trash bin. Lumi repairs the bench (bench_repair_s) the first time E is pressed at it. Yard builds are bought in the Hub tab: requires_level is the hub level, requires_flag a GameState flag (first_sprout = the first seed has grown). pos is [x, z] in the yard (CityLayout.YARD_HALF = 8.5; the fence runs along the back and both sides, the front at +z is open). Keep every yard interactable at least min_gap metres from the next.

radio.name: CD Player
radio.desc: A chunky old CD player on a crate by the fence. Plays the discs you find.

nursery.name: Robot Nursery
nursery.desc: A walled lawn with flower beds where retired robots tend the garden and lend your crew a hand.
